headline: Fed Chairman Warsh Seeks to Calm Elevated Inflation Concerns
context: In a high-profile speech, Kevin M. Warsh said the Federal Reserve was chiefly responsible for taming inflation. If price increases do not return to the central bank’s target quickly, “we have work to do,” he said.
